verdict.rationale: First-party blog claims 'Ask Expensify AI' lets users create/categorize/tag/approve/reject expenses and configure workspaces via plain language, directly matching the story, but this is vendor marketing copy with no independent/hands-on verification of the natural-language feature itself. Community evidence discusses categorization accuracy and UX issues but doesn't specifically test or contradict the AI natural-language assistant. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that the AI chat actually executes commands reliably, details on scope/limits of supported natural-language operations, and evidence it's broadly available rather than a beta/blog announcement.
